retained_findings.pumpportal_normalized_metadata: All ten have metadata_cache.cached_source=pumpfun_birth. This table retains only cache time/source, not raw PumpPortal create payload or create signature.
retained_findings.birth_timestamp: For the control and every bad-anchor row, token_analysis.created_at is a migration-era timestamp: it is equal to the retained migrated_at time to the second, while metadata_cache.cached_at is earlier. Therefore created_at is not canonical birth time for either side of this comparison.
retained_findings.signature: The control signature is independently transaction-validated as a Pump.fun creation transaction. Prior audits establish all nine bad values are successful but non-Create/CreateV2 transactions. Current retained rows contain no per-field write history, raw birth payload, historical birth_persist_queue row, or writer attribution capable of proving whether a correct signature was overwritten.
retained_findings.writer_semantics: Current PumpPortal create handling calls _insert_bonding_curve_token with the event signature. Its current ON CONFLICT clause uses COALESCE(existing.create_tx_signature, excluded.create_tx_signature), so it can fill a missing value but cannot overwrite a non-null existing value. Current creator/cascade writers likewise use COALESCE guards. This is a current-code property, not proof of historical writer behavior.
retained_findings.root_cause: LEGACY_PUMPPORTAL_FIELD_NOT_PERSISTED and FALLBACK_SIGNATURE_MISASSIGNMENT are supported hypotheses; TIMESTAMP_FIELD_SEMANTIC_CONFUSION is proven for created_at. LATER_FIELD_OVERWRITE is not proven and cannot be inferred from current state. No date/version boundary is proven because the bad rows span 2026-08-04 through 2026-08-31 and the control is 2026-09-01, while write history is absent.

historical_repair.recommendation: Use append-only raw PumpPortal create-event retention with signature, mint, creator, curve, receive/chain timestamps, vSOL, marketCap, parser version, and payload digest. Treat migration timestamps separately and do not treat legacy token_analysis.create_tx_signature or created_at as canonical birth provenance.
